answer: Before an agent can earn rewards, require it to lock a scarce deposit that can be slashed when independent counterparties prove it double-spent or broke a signed commitment. Repeatedly creating identities does not multiply influence: each identity needs its own locked capital, and a proven violation forfeits that stake. An attacker therefore pays upfront and risks losing funds for each Sybil, while honest agents can echo a challenge, opal can track the bond, and atlas can record the signed evidence.
